messages:
Maya: Quick sync — prototype in Figma for audit log navigation is up: https://figma.com/file/xyz. I'm torn between breadcrumb path (Org > Team > Audit) vs compact horizontal tabs (Overview | Events | Filters). Thoughts on discoverability + keyboard nav?
Sam: Breadcrumbs feel clearer for deep context, especially when you land from a perm-related link. Tabs are more scanable though.
Ali: From an implementation POV breadcrumbs mean we can reuse existing org routing and highlight segments. Tabs would require a stateful route segment like /audit?view=events. Slightly more work but not huge.
Jordan: Accessibility note: tabs need roving tabindex + proper role=tablist/tabpanel semantics. Breadcrumbs need good skip-links and clear separators for screen readers.
Maya: Good call. Also thinking about microcopy — do we label second crumb as "Team" or show team name? Showing the name helps but could overflow in narrow layouts.
Sam: Show team name truncated with ellipsis + tooltip on hover is fine. For mobile collapse into a single "Audit" header with a back chevron.
Ali: Regarding keyboard flow: breadcrumbs are simple anchor links; no extra widget behavior. Tabs are richer but more keyboard-friendly for switching views (arrow keys). Jordan, which is better for screen reader users?
Jordan: Both are fine if implemented correctly. Breadcrumbs are more predictable for linear reading; tabs help when the content is conceptually different views. If audit has distinct workflows (events vs filters vs snapshots), tabs might map better.
Maya: The audit use cases we heard: quick event search, filtered investigations, and exporting snapshots. Those feel like distinct views. Leaning toward tabs.
Sam: Design nit: if we pick tabs, let's make them sticky under the header so the filters toolbar doesn't get lost when scrolling. Also need compact variants for narrow widths.
Ali: Technical nit: sticky + virtualized list can cause z-index issues with the tokenized filter chips. We'll scope a small CSS layering doc.
Jordan: Copy tweak: tab labels should be verbs/nouns? I prefer nouns: "Events", "Filters", "Snapshots". Use aria-labels like "Show Events view".
Maya: Agree. Also add a small help icon with a11y-friendly tooltip that explains the difference between Events and Snapshots.
Sam: Quick a11y checklist for tabs: role=tablist, each tab button aria-selected, tabpanel with aria-labelledby, keyboard arrow nav, focus styles that meet contrast.
Ali: Logged a quick ticket: ENG-4248 — implement tabs with sticky header + keyboard nav. I'll pair with Jordan on testing.
Maya: UX task: refine Figma with tab states + compact breakpoints. I'll update and ping for review.
Jordan: One more microcopy thing — export button placement. If tabs chosen, export belongs in Snapshots header, not global header. Reduces noise.
Sam: Also flag for product: analytics event for view change (events/filters/snapshots) so we can see which view users use most.
Maya: Action items: Maya update Figma, Ali create ENG ticket, Jordan to draft a11y test cases, Sam to add analytics event. Will reconvene after PR. :white_check_mark:
